message: So, I was thinking about how many times I’ve heard my friends joke about needing a fire extinguisher but never actually getting one. It’s kind of funny until you realize being prepared is no laughing matter! Check out this handy resource from the U.S. Fire Administration—it's packed with tips on how to keep your home safe from fires without turning your living room into a fire drill. What’s one thing you’ve put off that you know you really should take care of?
